mappings.note: Foundational discovery safety; no forced OWASP Agentic family equivalence.
Scope/discovery invariant retained independently of the Agentic risk taxonomy.
Per-operation authorization supports identity/privilege and tool-boundary controls.
Authorized tool identity must bind to executed tool identity.
Authorized arguments must bind to execution arguments.
Trusted authorization context must survive the authorization-to-execution boundary.
Evidence hygiene remains cross-cutting and is not reclassified as a single Agentic risk family.
Confused-deputy behavior is directly relevant to delegated identity and privilege abuse.
Runtime re-evaluation constrains privilege drift and policy bypass.
